target.note: The species of the viewer's planarian atlas and catalogue. Evidence categories are given relative to it

evidence_categories.measured_exact: Measured in the species of the viewer's planarian atlas, Schmidtea mediterranea
evidence_categories.related_strain: Measured in another planarian species (a transferable prior with uncertainty)
evidence_categories.reconstituted: Measured on a planarian protein in a reconstructed system: heterologous cells or an expressed fragment
evidence_categories.inferred_fitted: Inferred or fitted from measurements, or from sequence data
evidence_categories.other_simulator: Predicted by a model or simulator
evidence_categories.method: A protocol: it describes a measurement and reports none of its own
evidence_categories.not assigned: The species is not stated in what was read, so no category relative to the target can be given

read_levels.full text searched: The open full text, or the author manuscript in PMC, was fetched and searched for the animals used, sequence records, data deposits and methods; the passages found were read. The paper was not read from end to end
read_levels.abstract only: Only the abstract in the bibliographic record was read; the full text was not open to this audit
read_levels.record only: The bibliographic record has no abstract: only its title and details were read

licence_classes.permissive: CC BY, CC0, or a plain statement that no restriction is placed on use: values may be given from it, with attribution
licence_classes.non-commercial: A CC BY-NC licence of any kind: named so that it can be read; no value is taken from it
licence_classes.no stated terms: No open licence is stated: named so that it can be read; no value is taken from it

families.cav: Voltage-gated calcium channels and their subunits
families.store_channels: Release channels of the calcium store (IP3 receptor, ryanodine receptor)
families.tissue: No protein named: voltage, fields or transport of the whole tissue

how_it_was_made.rule: A statement is in a record only if it was read in the paper's abstract, its open text or a data record. No table, trace or figure is copied. claims_checked.evidence: In situ maps of innexins, of all solute carriers, of TRPM and PKD genes, and two single-cell atlases with public data

claims_checked.claim: Data on what a channel law needs, conductances and gating measured on a planarian channel, is thin and is still borrowed from other species
claims_checked.evidence: Thin, but not absent. One Schmidtea mediterranea channel, TRPA1, was patch-clamped in a heterologous cell. Native sodium, calcium and potassium currents were voltage-clamped in cells of two other planarians (Bdelloura candida, 1993 and 1994; Girardia tigrina, 2003), and an IP3 receptor fragment's binding affinity was measured. None of this is on the channels the atlas draws for Schmidtea mediterranea, and only abstracts of the current recordings were read, so whether they give numbers a law could use is not known

claims_checked.claim: Several of the best-known experiments were done in Dugesia japonica, not Schmidtea mediterranea
claims_checked.evidence: The pump block with dye imaging, the octanol and two-headed work, the innexin triple knockdown, praziquantel and the calcium channels, the barium adaptation and the IP3 receptor are all Dugesia japonica
